notes.title: ASTRONAUTILUS - loopbreaker update
notes.content:
Long time, no update!

https://i.imgur.com/NfrLIly.png
https://i.imgur.com/3GsFyza.png
https://i.imgur.com/Ix7ZqUt.png
https://i.imgur.com/iVbrBKQ.png

loopbreaker is a large free update for ASTRONAUTILUS. It will add:

 4 new weapons
 4 new upgrades
 2 new characters
 7 new bosses
 1 new zone
 1 new final boss
 many polish and QOL changes
 an overarching storyline, with cutscenes and improved dialog
 6 quests with unique gameplay tied into the story
 14+ new music tracks, including guest tracks

On top of all of the new content, this update will give players a much deeper understanding of the world of CARCINA and all of the inhabitants within - I'm looking forward to seeing people play through it. Coming to Steam and itch.io late 2025!
